thread:
Morgan: starting thread for EdgeFrame POC (regional bank). They want SSO via SAML, SCIM provisioning with group->role mapping, domain ownership verification, and a price comparison for a short Dedicated trial vs a Private deployment. Need answers before Friday kickoff.
Lina: noted. I'll draft SAML and SCIM sample payloads. Quick question for EdgeFrame: do they require NameID = transient or persistent? Also any custom SCIM extension attrs (e.g., employeeType/team_id)?
Raj: For RBAC we should propose a minimal schema: SCIM groups map to Redwood roles, plus optional custom claim: roles[] in the token. Ask them for their canonical role list. For a POC, groups-only push is simplest.
Sasha: Pricing heads-up: 2-week Dedicated trial (1 small GPU pool + burst + basic support) estimate ~$5k. Private (single-tenant VPC bundle + on‑prem packaging for their infra team) is more involved; preliminary POC figure ~$15k due to infra work and security review. I'll formalize numbers with finance tomorrow. :clipboard:
Morgan: Customer's security questionnaire attached (they sent a doc). Highlights: SOC2 type II status, KMS/HSM options, tenant data isolation, retention policies, audit log export, and support for allowlisting CIDRs. @legal any immediate concerns?
legal: No blockers. For Private we can offer customer-managed KMS and out-of-band audit log export. We'll need to add a deployment-level addendum for HSM/KMS key control. Also confirm retention windows (they asked for 90 days vs default 30).
infra-bot: preview created: ef-poc-preview-2024-11-15. Egress IPs: 18.204.32.10, 18.205.14.9. SSH bastion ready.
Lina: SAML sample to share (send to customer for IdP mapping):
```xml
<Subject>
  <NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent">user.id</NameID>
</Subject>
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="email">user.email</Attribute>
  <Attribute Name="displayName">user.name</Attribute>
  <Attribute Name="groups">user.groups</Attribute>
  <Attribute Name="employeeType">user.employeeType</Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>
```
Lina: SCIM examples (v2) for user + group push: request rate: default 10 req/s, delta support with /Bulk for large orgs.
```json
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"userName":"jdoe","emails":[{"value":"jdoe@edgeframe.com","primary":true}],"groups":[{"value":"ops","display":"Ops"}]}
```
Raj: Note on propagation: internal eventual consistency ~10-20s for RBAC changes. If they need immediate enforcement, recommend Dedicated or Private with webhook eventing and shorter cache TTLs.
Morgan: Action list: 1) Lina share SAML + SCIM snippets with EdgeFrame and ask for NameID preference + any SCIM extensions. 2) Ask customer to export their role list and expected sync cadence (delta or full). 3) Sasha to deliver Dedicated vs Private POC quote + support/compliance add-ons. 4) Legal to draft questionnaire responses and provisional deployment addendum for KMS. 5) Infra to provision preview and allowlist IPs for their SSO testing.
Sasha: I'll push a two-column quote (Dedicated trial vs Private POC) with line items for support, compliance review, and extra engineering time. Draft by tomorrow noon.
Morgan: I'll ping the customer for role export and confirm retention ask (they mentioned 90 days).
Lina: Also asking whether they prefer domain proof via TXT record or email verification for domain binding. Recommend TXT for automation.
Morgan: Great. Let's reconvene after quotes are in. :thumbsup:
